🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 15, 2026

Sun, in Virgo, holds a sextile to Mars, in its fall in Cancer. Two different appetites, forced into one conversation: what you hold gets named without shrinking in the telling.

Easier — Letting go of something you had kept out of habit.
Harder — Wide gestures, vague promises, starting on appetite alone.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you, fallen in Cancer. Mercury in Libra stands opposite, and what you value is quoted back. Fire opens the file, and the file has a price. Unchanged for two weeks: you know what it asks.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Sun trines you from Virgo, meeting no resistance. Earth keeps what it has, cheaply. Venus left Libra four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Libra, untitled. Sun squares you from Virgo, and the cost objects. Mutable air: every option kept is an option paid for. Mercury has been out of Leo for four weeks now.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, unsupported in Scorpio. Its one tight contact: square to Jupiter. From Virgo, Sun hands you an opening. Water that starts things, started cheaply. The trine of a week ago is off it now.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, holds no rank in Virgo and simply works. Moon in Scorpio presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Fire that holds on, charged for holding. Two weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Libra with no title of its own. Sun is with you, close enough to read the small print. Earth changes shape until there is only one shape. What pressed two weeks ago has cleared.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. Mars squares you from Cancer, and something has to give way. Air moves first and pays first. Three weeks ago Venus was still held by Saturn; that is finished.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, has no support in Cancer and asks twice for half. Sun sextiles you from Virgo: a door left ajar. Fixed water keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. Saturn let go of it a week ago.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. It squares Moon in Scorpio. From Virgo, Sun cuts across the appetite. Fire bends, and each bend is invoiced. The hold Moon had a week ago is not there any more.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. From Virgo, Sun makes it easy, which is not the same as right. Cardinal earth: beginning costs almost nothing. It has stood four weeks; by now the cost is known.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Mercury in Libra sides with you before you have argued. Air keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. The trine to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. From Virgo, Sun returns your estimate with corrections. Mutable water: keeping options is the expense. This was not here last week, and has no history yet.
